events.title: The Department of Defense establishes AARO
events.evidence: On July 20, 2022, the Department of Defense established the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office to study, collect data, and report on UAP.

events.title: The New York Times publishes its investigation of the Pentagon's UFO program
events.evidence: On Saturday, December 16, 2017, their story appeared online; it was printed on the front page the next day.

events.title: ODNI submits the 2022 Annual Report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
events.evidence: On January 12, 2023, the ODNI submitted the 2022 Annual Report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena.

events.title: AARO's FY2023 consolidated UAP report is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena; cleared for open publication Oct 17, 2023.

events.title: AARO launches its public website and secure reporting mechanism
events.evidence: On October 31, 2023, AARO launched the aaro.mil website, featuring a secure mechanism for authorized reporting.

events.title: AARO's Historical Record Report, Volume I, is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I; cleared for open publication Mar 06, 2024.

events.title: AARO's FY2024 consolidated UAP report is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Fiscal Year 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena; cleared for open publication Nov 07, 2024.
